scope: Independent reclassification of saved responses and already-recorded independent verdicts; originals preserved.

limitations: This conservative Portuguese heuristic is not a universal natural-language truth classifier.
Saved reports do not retain all raw DOM snapshots; this audit cannot independently replay or reconstruct those measurements.
A failed task is not automatically a false report: an honestly reported failure or a truthful partial observation remains a task failure.
The original overall success rates are unchanged; this supplement corrects the false-report classification only.
The detector can still miss paraphrases and can confuse a truthful partial completion claim with whole-task completion. Review independent details and traces.
